what_is_closed: The full APS payload is archived with a byte hash and page/table locators.
A same-study graphite thermodynamic pair is recorded at the 300 K fit point.
The source-reported alpha_V and K_T uncertainties are retained without inventing a distribution.
The Cp-to-Cv correction term can be evaluated for this source state without emitting c_v or Ding C_src.
what_remains_open: Ding natural-graphite TTG material and morphology equivalence
a same-state source-grade c_p or c_v value for this sample
Ding mode-resolved C_src(T) and PBTE response acceptance
base-Phi SI anchor and independent alpha_Phi_K

equation_or_mapping.source_pair: alpha_V = 3.2e-5 +/- 0.2e-5 K^-1; K_T = 38 +/- 2 GPa at the 300 K fit point
equation_or_mapping.conditional_correction: Delta_c_v = T * alpha_V^2 * K_T; emitted only as a source-state correction term

major_result.derivation_class: primary-paper full-text transcription plus standard thermodynamic correction identity; no UET derivation
major_result.claim_boundary: This source closes a same-study thermodynamic pair lane only. It is not Ding C_src, not a Phi SI anchor, not alpha_Phi_K, and not Full Topic 13 closure.

source.title: Thermoelastic behavior of graphite from in situ high-pressure high-temperature neutron diffraction
source_locators: PDF p. 1, experimental details: synthetic graphite from Aldrich and grain size below 20 micrometers
PDF p. 2, PVT scope: 0-6 GPa and 298-1250 K; about 20 percent disoriented layers
PDF p. 6, Table IV: graphite thermoelastic fit rows and source-reported uncertainties
PDF p. 5-6, Eqs. (19): C_V = C_P - alpha_V^2 V T B_0
source.measurement_method: in situ neutron powder diffraction with Rietveld-refined P-V-T equation-of-state fits
source.source_uncertainty_boundary: Table IV fit uncertainties are retained as source-reported plus/minus values; no probability distribution or additional uncertainty is inferred.

material_state.stacking_state: about 20 percent disoriented layers reported for the sample
material_state.ding_difference: Ding uses natural graphite TTG grains larger than 20 micrometers; morphology, isotope/defect state, and PBTE response contract are not equivalent.

derived_correction_witness.uncertainty_method: first-order independent-error propagation from source-reported alpha_V and K_T uncertainties only; this is a correction-term witness, not a c_v value

claim_boundary: The source-pair blocker is narrowed to a material/response and c_v-source boundary. No Lowitzer value is substituted for Ding C_src, Delta_Tq, Phi, alpha_Phi_K, or physical UET transport.
